column3: Shagbark hickory (Carya ovata), a true hickory, clear straight-grained small specimens at 12% moisture content
column4: FPL-GTR-282 Table 5-3a (metric), true hickories, 12% row: specific gravity 0.72 (footnote b: ovendry weight, volume at 12% moisture content); static bending modulus of elasticity 14,900 MPa from a simply supported, center-loaded beam at span/depth 14 (footnote c: increase by 10% to correct for shear deflection)
column5: Average clear-wood values, not a particular drumstick; drumstick hickory is sold without a species, and the four true hickories at 12% moisture content span specific gravity 0.69 to 0.75 and bending MOE 13,000 to 15,600 MPa (mockernut 0.72 and 15,300, pignut 0.75 and 15,600, shellbark 0.69 and 13,000; stored below). The isotropic young_modulus is the pack author's reduction for a Hertz stick tip: the longitudinal modulus E_L = 1.1 x 14,900 = 16,390 MPa (footnote c). Wood is orthotropic; its transverse moduli are about a tenth of E_L (Table 5-1 hardwood ratios), so a tip treated as isotropic in E_L is stiffer than the real tip. Density at 12% moisture content is specific gravity x 1.12 x 1000 kg/m^3 = 806.4 kg/m^3, the convention of this repository's other FPL-GTR-282 packs. Moisture content is fixed at 12% and is not an axis of this pack. Temperature: Table 5-15 gives MOE parallel to grain at 12% moisture content +17% at -50 C and -7% at +50 C relative to 20 C, approximately linear, so about 0.24% per degree; the rows are admitted from 15 to 25 C, where that effect is within 1.2%

column3: composition-proxy: mean longitudinal-radial Poisson's ratio of the 16 hardwoods of FPL-GTR-282 Table 5-2 at about 12% moisture content
column4: Arithmetic mean of the tabulated mu_LR of ash white, aspen quaking, balsa, basswood, birch yellow, cherry black, cottonwood eastern, mahogany African, mahogany Honduras, maple sugar, maple red, oak red, oak white, sweetgum, walnut black and yellow-poplar
column5: composition-proxy: hickory is not in Table 5-2, so this is NOT a hickory measurement. The mean is 0.371 (range 0.229 to 0.495; white ash, also a drumstick wood, is 0.371). For the Hertz stick-on-film contact of the kit, the full range changes the effective modulus by about 2%
